discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 3948f925a5. The continuation template now interpolates `{{escapeXml partialText}}`, so carried model output cannot close `<work-already-shown>` or open a `<system-injection>`. A test feeds a closing-tag payload and asserts it is escaped and the wrapper tags appear exactly once; it fails without the change.
